contrary_evidence: Eurostat's final energy rate rose relative to the flash estimate while the overall 4.0% rate was unchanged.
US manufacturing output rose 0.3% despite a 0.4% fall in aggregate industrial production.
The RBA recorded a divided six-to-three decision, evidencing uncertainty about optimal restrictive policy.
UK unemployment declined in a rolling-quarter survey while provisional payroll employment weakened.
US sovereign yields eased while multiple equity indexes fell.

The FOMC staff judged the banking system well capitalized and household balance sheets a buffer against financial shocks, even while flagging AI-related debt, opaque financing structures, elevated asset valuations and hedge-fund leverage.
limitations: The information cutoff is 18 Nov 2026 16:20 BRT; US and Brazilian equity closes refer to 17 Nov.
The European Commission 2026–2028 forecasts and Nvidia's next-quarter guidance are projections, while October Eurostat/ONS figures are observed outcomes.

Anthropic's $900.9 billion aggregate includes obligations and commitments with different legal forms; $186.2 billion is subject to termination rights or contingent conditions, $150–175 billion of additional non-fixed-dollar arrangements is excluded, and $4.2 billion of the $70.7 billion due within 12 months is conditional or terminable.

limitations: The exact publication hour of the IEA World Energy Outlook 2026 is not stated on its 19 November page.
IEA scenarios and system requirements are modelled pathways, not realised infrastructure, committed capital or guaranteed policy outcomes.
The 7 mb/d pipeline figure includes projects under construction or consideration; the Low Hormuz Case depends on multiple conditional assumptions.
US EIA inventories are a national weekly observation and cannot establish global diesel availability.
Treasury par yields do not measure private credit spreads, project-finance margins or sovereign borrowing spreads.
The Asian equity figures are closing returns from The Edge's 19 November closing edition, first published at 11:08 GMT; they are not the earlier 03:51 GMT intraday snapshot.
The World Bank debt aggregates are not energy-project debt and do not identify the financing terms of individual infrastructure projects.
The Brazil market move reflects domestic fiscal uncertainty as well as external dollar and rate conditions.
The 19 November Brent/WTI quote at 09:53 GMT is an intraday observation from a Reuters wire reproduced by Media Selangor, not a settlement.
contrary_evidence: Brent and WTI fell on 18 November and US commercial crude inventories rose in the week ended 13 November, consistent with a looser near-term crude balance.
The IEA expects oil supply to rebound in 2027, which could lower benchmark prices if the forecast materialises.
India's rupee remained resilient despite a stronger dollar, with reported November equity inflows supporting the currency.
US crude and distillate inventories increased in the latest weekly EIA balance, even while the IEA describes low global on-land stocks and tight diesel markets.
The IEA's grid and pipeline figures are system requirements and scenario assumptions, not proof of project bankability or implementation.

en.title: Global Macro — Energy security turns the Hormuz shock into a global capital-allocation test
en.deck: The IEA's new outlook quantifies the capital, equipment and financing needed to diversify energy supply and expand electricity grids, even as crude prices soften.
